responseMessageContents.text: The demo login currently only works in offline mode. Let me make it always work so the App Store reviewers can sign in regardless of Supabase state.

Done. The demo login now works regardless of Supabase configuration.

**Reviewer credentials:**
- Email: `appreview@peaknab.com`
- Password: `ReviewPeakNab2026!`

To navigate to login in the app: from any screen, tap the profile/settings icon or look for the "Sign In" button. The auth screen is at `/auth`. Once you enter those credentials, you'll be signed in as the demo reviewer — data stays local but the account persists.
